actions.reason: K3_C0001 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity: a strong immune/inflammatory program (allograft rejection, interferon alpha/gamma, IL6-JAK-STAT3, inflammatory response, complement) with a T-cell/antigen-presentation leading edge, plus nominal BAP1 enrichment (ER:c222463107da:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:1d912c7fc0; ER:c222463107da:biological_support:wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:1d912c7fc0). Membership independence is positively supported by set-scope native-geometry alignment showing weakly positive silhouettes in CT/RNA/WSI with within-set distances below between-set distances (ER:c222463107da:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:1d912c7fc0), and by pair-scope boundary representation against both neighbors: K3_C0001-K3_C0002 shows weakly positive silhouettes in all four modalities with within-below-between in CT/RNA/WSI (ER:c222463107da:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:ee6f87ccd2) and K3_C0001-K3_C0003 shows weakly positive silhouettes in all four modalities with within-below-between in all four (ER:c222463107da:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:5891086e94). The material counterevidence is the set-scope confounder association: tissue_source_site and ct_scanner_model are associated with K3_C0001 membership (ER:c222463107da:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:set:1d912c7fc0), and the partition-wide screen shows broad technical/acquisition association (ER:c222463107da:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:partition:e3b0c44298); these are associations, not proof of artifact, and they do not neutralize the directionally consistent boundary representation, so retention is justified while the technical concern remains noted.

K3_C0002 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity: a metabolic/secretory program (protein secretion, oxidative phosphorylation, fatty acid metabolism, adipogenesis, mTORC1) with a vesicle-trafficking leading edge and allograft rejection down, plus nominal PBRM1/VHL depletion (ER:c222463107da:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:d8adc0a39b; ER:c222463107da:biological_support:wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:d8adc0a39b). Membership independence is positively supported by set-scope native-geometry alignment showing weakly positive silhouettes in all four modalities with within-set distances below between-set distances in all four (ER:c222463107da:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:d8adc0a39b), and by pair-scope boundary representation against both neighbors: K3_C0001-K3_C0002 shows weakly positive silhouettes in all four modalities with within-below-between in CT/RNA/WSI (ER:c222463107da:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:ee6f87ccd2) and K3_C0002-K3_C0003 shows weakly positive silhouettes in all four modalities with within-below-between in CT/RNA/WXS (ER:c222463107da:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:c8b5e3ff3c). The material counterevidence is the set-scope confounder association: tissue_source_site, ct_scanner_model, ct_manufacturer, ct_reconstruction_kernel, ct_phase, ct_z_spacing, ct_slice_thickness, and study_year are associated with K3_C0002 membership (ER:c222463107da:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:set:d8adc0a39b), and the partition-wide screen shows broad technical/acquisition association (ER:c222463107da:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:partition:e3b0c44298); these are associations, not proof of artifact, and they do not neutralize the uniformly directed boundary representation, so retention is justified while the technical concern remains noted.

K3_C0003 has an interpretable biological phenotype (broad down-regulation of immune/inflammatory, oxidative phosphorylation, and proliferation programs with UV-response-DN/Wnt/TGF-beta up, and nominal PBRM1/VHL enrichment with BAP1 depletion) (ER:c222463107da:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:c3d03e2c9e; ER:c222463107da:biological_support:wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:c3d03e2c9e), but independent membership is not positively supported. Set-scope native-geometry alignment shows little and modality-inconsistent representation: only RNA is weakly positive while CT, WSI, and WXS are null-to-slightly-negative with within-set distances exceeding between-set distances in those three modalities (ER:c222463107da:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:c3d03e2c9e). Pair-scope boundary evidence is weak and modality-dependent: K3_C0002-K3_C0003 shows weakly positive silhouettes but no within-below-between distinction in WSI (ER:c222463107da:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:c8b5e3ff3c), and K3_C0001-K3_C0003 shows only weak separation with the weakest contrast in CT and WXS (ER:c222463107da:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:5891086e94). The set-scope confounder association (tissue_source_site, ct_phase, ct_manufacturer, ct_slice_thickness, ct_z_spacing) is a further unresolved technical concern for this membership (ER:c222463107da:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:set:c3d03e2c9e), and the partition-wide screen shows broad technical/acquisition association (ER:c222463107da:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:partition:e3b0c44298). With membership representation weak and modality-inconsistent and no supported internal subdivision, decision-relevant evidence is exhausted and retention as an independent unit is not justified.
